items.headline: Chabad of Sunnyvale seeks permit for new worship space
items.summary: Chabad of Sunnyvale is applying for a use permit to operate a religious assembly space inside an existing commercial building at 645 W. Fremont Avenue, which sits in an R-1 residential zone.

items.headline: NVIDIA rack permit carries $1.66M valuation
items.summary: San José issued a permit for an NVIDIA rack installation at 300 Holger Way, an R&D Lab tenant improvement with a declared permit valuation of $1,664,913.

items.headline: 5-unit condo building permitted on Florence Avenue
items.summary: San José issued a permit for a five-unit condominium building at 2820 Florence Avenue, with a declared permit valuation of $1,381,899.

items.headline: Fire truck manufacturers listed in closed-session agenda
items.summary: The September 22 City Council agenda listed a potential legal matter involving Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh Corporation, REV Group, Rosenbauer America, and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association.

items.headline: City attorney appointment listed in closed-session agenda
items.summary: The September 22 City Council closed-session agenda listed a public employee appointment item for the City Attorney position.

items.headline: 408-unit El Camino Real housing proposal listed for public hearing
items.summary: The September 22 City Council agenda listed a public hearing on prezoning, a General Plan land use designation, annexation, and a subdivision map for 408 residential units at 451-475 El Camino Real, with an Environmental Impact Report prepared under CEQA.

items.headline: Cubberley property negotiations listed in council agenda
items.summary: The September 22 City Council closed-session agenda listed a conference with real property negotiators for 4000 Middlefield Road, the Cubberley Community Center site, covering purchase, exchange, and/or lease price and payment terms with the Palo Alto Unified School District.
